DEPARTMENT OF ELECTRICAL & COMPUTER SYSTEMS
PACIFIC COAST UNIVERSITY
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Priya Sharma, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2012-2015) at Pacific Coast University.

During this tenure, Priya Sharma demonstrated exceptional mastery in Computer Vision, OpenCV, TensorFlow, Edge AI. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Graph Neural Networks for Large-Scale Knowledge Graph Completion', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Priya Sharma displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Priya Sharma among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. K. V. Ramanathan
Dean of Academic Research
Electrical & Computer Systems
Pacific Coast University
Email: .k..v..ramanathan@pacificcoa.edu
